// Positive control (#5170): the verb declares its exit on the `ok` branch only; with `ok` false control
// falls off the end of the function with the exit never declared (no return statement to see).
import { output } from './io.cjs';
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';
import { gateVerdict } from './gate-verdict.cjs';

export function cmdFixtureVerb(ok: boolean, raw: boolean): void {
  if (ok) {
    output({ valid: true }, raw);
    declareGateExit(gateVerdict('pass', false, { valid: true }), 'status');
  }
}
